verdict.rationale: A community user describes Svelte's own interactive tutorial with in-browser sandboxes as a strong onramp. First-party docs only confirm an online playground, which is a sandbox rather than a guided tutorial, so the tutorial itself rests on a single older community report. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the interactive tutorial and its lesson structure, current-version evidence that the tutorial runs with no local setup, and the ability to eject a tutorial sandbox into a local build.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup

citations.quote: The interactive tutorial with sandboxes is really impressive and a great onramp
You can also try Svelte online in the playground.
